confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use Ipoh price panels updated in October 2026 as a nearby proxy for the July 2026 window; their contributor base is limited. The cocktail estimate has a local price entry. A typical wine-by-glass price was unavailable, so it is estimated above the RM18 pub-beer anchor, using the RM24 cocktail price and local wine-price context. Accommodation estimates are bounded by the supplied comparable-city prices and general knowledge, without checking live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Ipoh is likely toward the lower end of the supplied Malaysian city range for accommodation: below Penang and Malacca for three-star rooms, and near the low end of the basic-room and dorm prices. Its private-room estimate is below Penang and close to Kuala Lumpur and Malacca.
